tenderSchedule.title: Providing necessary barricading and cutouts for Banni Mudi and Ravana Dhahana programmes at Freedom Park on occassion of Shivamogga Dasara 2026.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing necessary barricading and cutouts for Banni Mudi and Ravana Dhahana programmes at Freedom Park on occassion of Shivamogga Dasara 2026.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates quoted by the tenderer should be exclusive of GST for item no.1 and 2 and inclusive of all taxes for all other items.
All other conditions as per bid document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Firm Registered Proprietor, Partnership, Public Sector or Private limited Company Registration certificate
Minimum financial turnover with UDIN not less than the estimated cost of this tender, from the annual payments for any 1 year in last 5 years
Tenderer in his name should have provided at least one similar service in any state level dasara event, certificate should be signed by Executive Engineer or equivalent authority.
Tenderer in his name should have turnover in last 5 financial years period i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN number.

itemList.itemName: Providing and supplying of portable steps of height 8 feet and width 10 feet on hire basis for 5 days
Providing temporary poles for media and street lights, providing portable steps of 10ft height and width 12ft in 3 places for videography and barricading for 10 lighting towers for 5 days.

Providing temporary Ravana model made up of cloth, card board, paper of height 25ft and top width 20ft, mid width 8 ft and bottom width 10ft structured with bamboo poles and placed on a bamboo platform of height 12ft and other arrangements to be made as instructed by officer in charge.
Providing and fixing 25 feet, 50 to 100 mm dia pole for lighting and electrification around bannimantapa on hire basis for 5 days

Providing & Erecting on Hire basis good quality MS Barricading of Standard specification inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work for 5 days.

Providing and fixing double scaffolding system (cup lock type) on the exterior side of building/structure, upto 25 metre height, above ground level, including additional rows of scaffolding in stepped manner as per requirement of site, made with 40mm dia M.S. tube, placed 1.5 metre centre to centre, horizontal & vertical tubes joint with cup & lock system with M.S. Tubes, M.S. tube challis, M.S. clamps and staircase system in the scaffolding for working platform etc.

Providing, erecting and removing casurina pole three tier BARRICADING using poles of 7.5 to 10 cms dia. and 1.5M height above ground fixed vertically at intervals of 2.0 to 2.5 M centre to centre and horizontally at 0.5M above ground level, including fixing poles in ground for a maximum depth of 0.3M and tied with coir rope firmly including cost and conveyances of all materials, labour, lead and lifts charges etc. complete. (This item is applicable for pipe works of 600mm dia and above pipes)
